title: The Fiery Furnace

questions.question: King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of what material?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:1 (ESV): "King Nebuchadnezzar made an image of gold,"

questions.question: What were all the people commanded to do when they heard the sound of the musical instruments?
options: Fall down and worship the golden image
questions.correctAnswer: Fall down and worship the golden image
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:5 (ESV): "you are to fall down and worship the golden image that King Nebuchadnezzar has set up."

questions.question: Who refused to serve the king's gods or worship the golden image?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:12 (ESV): "These men, O king, pay no attention to you; they do not serve your gods or worship the golden image that you have set up."

questions.question: What was the punishment for not worshipping the image?
options: Thrown into a burning fiery furnace
Thrown into a den of lions
questions.correctAnswer: Thrown into a burning fiery furnace
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:6 (ESV): "And whoever does not fall down and worship shall immediately be cast into a burning fiery furnace."

questions.question: How many men did the king see walking in the midst of the fire?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:25 (ESV): "But I see four men unbound, walking in the midst of the fire,"

questions.question: How hot did the king command the furnace to be heated?
options: Seven times more than it was usually heated
questions.correctAnswer: Seven times more than it was usually heated
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:19 (ESV): "ordered the furnace heated seven times more than it was usually heated."

questions.question: What happened to the men who threw Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego into the fire?
options: The flame of the fire killed them
questions.correctAnswer: The flame of the fire killed them
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:22 (ESV): "the flame of the fire killed those men who took up Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego."

questions.question: The fourth man in the fire had the appearance of whom?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:25 (ESV): "and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods."

questions.question: When the three men came out of the fire, what was NOT true about their condition?
options: The hair of their heads was not singed
No smell of fire had come upon them
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:27 (ESV): "the hair of their heads was not singed, their cloaks were not harmed, and no smell of fire had come upon them."

questions.question: The king made a decree that any people who speak anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be what?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:29 (ESV): "Therefore I make a decree: Any people... who speak anything against the God of Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego shall be torn limb from limb"

questions.question: Where was the image of gold set up?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:1 (ESV): "He set it up in the plain of Dura, in the province of Babylon."

questions.question: What instruments are listed as signaling the worship of the image?
options: Horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music
questions.correctAnswer: Horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:5 (ESV): "when you hear the sound of the horn, pipe, lyre, trigon, harp, bagpipe, and every kind of music,"

questions.question: Who maliciously accused the Jews to the king?
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:8 (ESV): "Therefore at that time certain Chaldeans came forward and maliciously accused the Jews."

questions.question: What was the height and breadth of the golden image?
options: Sixty cubits high and six cubits wide
Fifty cubits high and five cubits wide
questions.correctAnswer: Sixty cubits high and six cubits wide
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:1 (ESV): "Its height was sixty cubits and its breadth six cubits."

questions.question: What did the three men say God was able to do, even if He did not deliver them?
options: They would still not serve the king's gods
questions.correctAnswer: They would still not serve the king's gods
questions.explanation: Daniel 3:18 (ESV): "But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image that you have set up."

key_verse_text: If this be so, our God whom we serve is able to deliver us from the burning fiery furnace, and he will deliver us out of your hand, O king. But if not, be it known to you, O king, that we will not serve your gods or worship the golden image that you have set up.
